description: This source file defines the onboarding flow UI for an Android app built with Jetpack Compose. It includes multiple composable functions that manage the onboarding process such as connecting to a gateway via QR codes or manual entry, requesting permissions, confirming connection status, and final review. It handles user interactions, permissions, and gateway configuration details, guiding the user through setup steps with visual components.

classes.name: OnboardingStep
classes.description: Enumeration representing the different steps in the onboarding process (Welcome, Gateway, Permissions, FinalCheck).

classes.name: GatewayInputMode
classes.description: Enumeration for gateway input modes (SetupCode, Manual).

classes.name: PermissionToggle
classes.description: Enumeration representing various permissions toggles (Discovery, Location, Notifications, etc.).

classes.name: SpecialAccessToggle
classes.description: Enumeration for special access toggles, e.g., NotificationListener.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointConfig
classes.description: Configuration details of a parsed gateway endpoint, including display URL.

methods.name: OnboardingFlow
methods.description: Main composable function managing the entire onboarding flow, state, and user interactions.

methods.name: canFinishOnboarding
methods.description: Determines if onboarding can be finished based on connectivity status.

methods.name: onboardingPrimaryButtonColors
methods.description: Provides button color scheme for primary actions.

methods.name: onboardingTextFieldColors
methods.description: Provides color scheme for text fields.

methods.name: onboardingSwitchColors
methods.description: Provides color scheme for switches.

methods.name: StepRail
methods.description: Displays a progress indicator for onboarding steps.

methods.name: WelcomeStep
methods.description: Displays the welcome feature cards.

methods.name: GatewayStep
methods.description: Handles gateway connection setup, including QR scanning and manual input.

methods.name: GuideBlock
methods.description: Displays a titled informational block with icon and content.

methods.name: GatewayModeToggle
methods.description: UI for toggling between setup code and manual input modes.

methods.name: GatewayModeChip
methods.description: Clickable chip component for gateway mode selection.

methods.name: QuickFillChip
methods.description: Button for quick preset gateway configurations.

methods.name: ResolvedEndpoint
methods.description: Displays resolved gateway endpoint URL.

methods.name: StepShell
methods.description: Wrapper for displaying a step section title and content.

methods.name: InlineDivider
methods.description: Displays a horizontal divider.

methods.name: PermissionsStep
methods.description: UI for requesting permissions and toggles for various functionalities.

methods.name: PermissionSectionHeader
methods.description: Header title for permissions sections.

methods.name: PermissionToggleRow
methods.description: Row with toggle switch for each permission or feature.

methods.name: FinalStep
methods.description: Displays a review screen before finalizing onboarding, showing connection and configuration status.

methods.name: isPermissionGranted
methods.description: Checks if a specific permission is granted in the current context.

methods.name: qrScannerErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns an error message string for QR scanner failures.

methods.name: isNotificationListenerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if notification listener access is enabled.

methods.name: openNotificationListenerSettings
methods.description: Opens the notification listener settings screen.

methods.name: openAppSettings
methods.description: Opens the application details settings page.

methods.name: hasMotionCapabilities
methods.description: Detects whether device has motion sensor capabilities.
